correctness.rationale: The probability-normalized addition formula gives K_l(x,y)=(l+1)U_l(x·y). Orthogonality of the two circles forces a constant off-block, while each within-circle block is a cyclic convolution whose Fourier coefficients are the exact integers c_a. This yields 2(2m-1) nonconstant eigenvalues and two constant-mode eigenvalues, with no missing modes. Consecutive residues modulo m prove the full even/odd rank law, including l=0, m=2 and the l=2m threshold. The same null vector proves the signed quadrature relation. The independently constructed raw kernel passed 7,140 predicted eigenvector tests over 357 configurations; 2,299 exact arithmetic cross-checks pass.
